name: Lead Enrichment Pre-Attorney

parameters.content:
## Lead Enrichment Pre-Attorney

### How it works

1. The workflow triggers when a new lead is received via a webhook and parses the lead data.
2. It extracts the company domain from the lead's email and conditionally enriches the lead with company data if the email domain is business-related.
3. The enriched data is processed to compute a value signal, logged for tracking, and then compiled into a briefing for compliance auditing.
4. The briefing is sent via email to relevant recipients.
5. Separately, a scheduled trigger weekly processes and summarizes lead enrichment logs.
6. It builds and sends a weekly lead quality summary email reporting on the lead value and company profiles encountered.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Configure the webhook node 'When New Lead Received' to receive leads from the source system.
- [ ] Set the environment variable ENRICHMENT_API_URL with the API endpoint URL for company enrichment data.
- [ ] Provide Google Sheets credentials and ensure access to the relevant sheet for logging enrichment data and reading weekly logs.
- [ ] Provide email credentials for the 'Send Lead Enrichment Briefing' and 'Send Weekly Lead Quality Summary Email' nodes.
- [ ] Configure the schedule trigger 'Check Weekly Lead Quality Summary' for desired weekly runtime.

### Customization

- Adjust the company enrichment API URL and parsing logic in 'Fetch Company Enrichment Data' and 'Parse Company Enrichment Response' to match your provider's response format.
- Customize the logic in 'Compute Matter Value Signal' to reflect your business rules for lead prioritization.
- Modify email templates and recipients in the email send nodes to suit your communication style and audience.

## Lead input and parsing

Starts with receiving a new lead via webhook and parsing the lead data including extracting the company domain from the email.

## Company data enrichment

Fetches company enrichment data based on business email domain or handles absence of company signal, then parses and computes a matter value signal.

## Logging and briefing construction

Logs the lead enrichment data for tracking, builds a briefing, and triggers compliance audit workflow.

## Send lead briefing email

Sends the prepared lead enrichment briefing email to recipients.

## Weekly lead quality summary trigger and reading

Triggers on schedule weekly to read the enrichment log for aggregation.

## Weekly summary computation and emailing

Computes weekly quality summary from logged data, builds and sends an email report summarizing lead value tiers and companies encountered.

nodes.notes: Wire your intake form or lead source's webhook/notification settings to POST here.

nodes.name: Parse Incoming Lead Data
nodes.notes: Field names here match common intake form defaults — adjust to your actual lead source's field names if they differ.

nodes.name: Extract Company Domain From Email
nodes.notes: CONSUMER_EMAIL_DOMAINS controls what counts as 'not a company' — add any other free providers common among your leads.

nodes.name: If Email Has Business Domain
nodes.notes: True continues to attempt an enrichment lookup; false means it's a personal/consumer email with nothing to look up.

nodes.name: Fetch Company Enrichment Info
nodes.notes: ENRICHMENT_API_URL and this node's Header Auth credential point at whatever enrichment provider you've signed up for (Clearbit, Apollo, Hunter, etc.) — swap both for your actual provider's endpoint and key format.

nodes.name: Parse Company Enrichment Data
nodes.notes: The real provider's response fields WILL differ — check this against your actual enrichment provider's live response and adjust field names accordingly.

nodes.name: Note Missing Company Signal
nodes.notes: A personal/consumer email domain — nothing to enrich, so the briefing just says so rather than guessing.

nodes.name: Compute Matter Value Score
nodes.notes: HIGH_VALUE_KEYWORDS is the entire signal — edit this n8n Variable to match language your firm actually associates with higher-value matters.

nodes.name: Append Enrichment Data To Sheets
nodes.notes: Every lead gets logged, enriched or not — useful for reviewing how often enrichment actually finds something over time. Column headers must match exactly.

nodes.name: Build Enrichment Briefing Report
nodes.notes: The actual research head start the attorney receives — company signal, value tier, and the raw inquiry, all in one place.

nodes.name: Log Briefing For Audit Workflow
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — this goes to the firm's own attorney, not the lead, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored, same internal-notification pattern used throughout this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Lead Enrichment Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Lead Enrichment Briefing' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Read Weekly Enrichment Sheet
nodes.notes: Reads the full log — filtered down to the trailing week in the next step, since Sheets doesn't filter server-side here.

nodes.name: Compute Weekly Lead Summary
nodes.notes: LEAD_SUMMARY_LOOKBACK_DAYS controls the window — defaults to 7.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Summary Email
nodes.notes: Explicitly sends a 'no leads this week' message rather than a blank digest when nothing came in.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Summary Email
nodes.notes: This is an internal, firm-wide summary, not tied to any single lead — no guardrail wrap needed, matching the internal-summary pattern used elsewhere in this catalog (e.g. PAC-75's weekly digest).

body.name: Morgan Lee
body.case_description: We're facing a commercial litigation dispute worth roughly $2,000,000 over a breached supply contract.

description: Fires on every new lead. Checks the email domain for a company signal, enriches it through a firm-configured provider if found, scans the case description for firm-configured value keywords, logs every lead, and emails the attorney a research briefing before they'd otherwise see the raw lead. The value tier is a keyword-based sorting heuristic, never a legal or financial valuation (ABA Op. 512). Replaces Clay and ZoomInfo subscriptions for this specific pre-attorney research step.
